narr: The remnants of Tropical Storm Ida moved north-northeast across the lower Mississippi Valley, spreading moisture northward. Some frontal forcing in the mid levels of the atmosphere across southern Indiana and southern Illinois initiated scattered showers and thunderstorms, some of which produced heavy rainfall.
ev: A significant amount of water was reported across Highway 136 just east of Livermore.

Major street flooding was reported in central Owensboro. At least one car was stalled in floodwater. A rainfall total of 2.29 inches from the afternoon storms was measured at a co-op observer site on the east side of the city.
